Several real hours (Tibia's day/night cycle forces several waits), plus the time to loot the Broken Longbows

On **Bounac**, the secret island of the Order of the Lion, the Usurpers are besieging the castle of King {npc:Kesar the Younger}. Help the miller {npc:Evrard the Miller} steal the ledger and the map from the enemy camp, win the trust of five townsfolk with the password **Yselda**, get into the castle, kill {creature:Fugue} and, at the end, defeat {creature:Drume} on the battlefield. You receive the achievement **Lionheart**, the title **Hero of Bounac**, access to the whole town (including the depot) and the chance to kill Drume to loot pieces of the {wiki:Lion Set|Lion Set}.
Earn the trust of the Order of the Lion and help them fight the usurpers who are trying to take control of their castle.
Evrard the Miller, mill in the north of Bounac (daytime only)

The {spell:Levitate} spell, to reach the crate with the map on the Usurpers' ship.

Adventures of Galthen Quest (mission Galthen and the Lost Queen)
The mission *Galthen and the Lost Queen* requires The Order of the Lion Quest to be completed.

The quest depends on Tibia's day/night cycle: the Tibian **day** corresponds, in real time, to the period between minutes **:15 and :45** of each hour; the **night** runs from :45 to :15. A full Tibian day lasts **one real hour**. Expect some waiting.

You can start without the Orders of the Falcon and the Cobra: you only need them when {npc:Kesar the Younger} asks you to escort him to Drume. If you do not have them yet, he sends you to investigate the other orders.

In Bounac there are {wiki:Members of the Order of the Lion|Lions} and Usurpers fighting each other. The Lions do not attack you, which makes it easier to walk around the city, but if you kill a Lion you end up in prison for a few seconds: be careful with area spells near them.

{item:Broken Longbow|Broken Longbows} only drop from {creature:Usurper Archer|Usurper Archers} (about 15.6%), but they can be traded on the Market. The {creature:Deer} you will kill for Dal often drop {item:Ham}.
In monster-killing tasks, the kill counts for whoever dealt the most damage. In a group, each player has to kill the full amount.
To hunt in Bounac, the wiki recommends level 250 with 100/100 skills (knights and paladins) or magic level 80 (mages).
Bounac is an island between Thais and Meriana. Only characters of level 250 or higher can enter.

Go to **Edron**: for example, in Thais {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 160 gp). Before going to Bounac, gather the 20 {item:Ham} and the 10 {item:Bread} now: in Edron, {npc:Mirabell} (tavern above the depot) sells both ({key:hi}, {key:trade}); the {item:Broken Longbow|Broken Longbows} you loot there or buy on the Market. Then look for the small boat **north** of the Edron mountain pass (marked point): that is how you travel to **Bounac**.

In Bounac you will find the {wiki:Members of the Order of the Lion|members of the Order of the Lion} and the Usurpers, who are trying to take control of the Order. The two groups fight each other and the Lions **do not attack you**. If you kill a Lion, you are sent to prison for a few seconds.
Do not attack the Lions ({creature:Lion Knight}, {creature:Lion Archer}, {creature:Lion Warlock}, {creature:Lion Commander}) and be careful with area spells when they are nearby.
2. Evrard the Miller: the ledger and the map
This first part can only be done **during the day** (between minutes :15 and :45 of each real hour), because Evrard only appears during the day.

Go to the mill in the **north** of Bounac, on the ground floor, and talk to {npc:Evrard the Miller}. Say {key:hi} and answer {key:yes} to both questions. He wants two things from the Usurpers' camp, to the **east**: a *ledger* and a *map*.
Go down the stairs next to the mill at {coord:32427,32461,7}, follow the cave **southeast** and come back up to the surface. You are in the area of the Usurpers' camp, next to the harbour.
Stairs to the cave (next to the mill)
The camp is full of Usurpers ({creature:Usurper Archer}, {creature:Usurper Knight}, {creature:Usurper Warlock}), strong level 250+ monsters.
The *Ledger* (a scroll) is inside a book, in the small house **south** of the ship. Open the book and take it.
The *Map* is on the ship, on the **lower deck**, inside a crate. To get there, use {spell:Levitate} **down** in front of the ship's stairs. Open the crate and take the map.
Usurpers' ship (the crate is on the lower deck)
Where the Map is, on the ship's lower deck

Go back up to the ship's deck (if there are no stairs to go up, use {spell:Levitate} up) and return the same way: go down into the cave, follow it **northwest** and go up the stairs next to Evrard's mill ({coord:32427,32461,7}).
Stairs next to the mill (cave exit)

During the day, talk to {npc:Evrard the Miller} again: {key:hi}, {key:news}, {key:yes} and, when he asks whether you were quiet, {key:yes}. He does not keep the objects (you can keep them), opens an **underground route** to the city for you and gives you the password **YSELDA**.
Access to the south side of the island (the city) and the password Yselda
3. Earning the trust of the inhabitants (Yselda)
In the city you have to help five NPCs. They all accept and hand in the task with the word {key:Yselda}, day or night, wherever they are. You can do the five tasks in any order.

Go down the same stairs next to the mill ({coord:32427,32461,7}), but this time follow the cave **straight south** and go up the stairs at the end. You are in the city of Bounac. The NPCs change places between day and night: use the maps below.
Wes the Blacksmith: getting the task
Talk to {npc:Wes the Blacksmith}: {key:hi}, {key:Yselda} and {key:Yselda} again. He asks you for about **20 {item:Broken Longbow|Broken Longbows}** from fallen Usurpers.

Kill {creature:Usurper Archer|Usurper Archers} in Bounac until you have 20 {item:Broken Longbow|Broken Longbows}. Only this monster drops them (about 15.6% per kill), so expect a lot of kills; alternatively, buy them on the Market.
Usurper Archers attack at range with Death Arrow and Sudden Death (up to about 545 damage per hit).
With the 20 longbows, tell {npc:Wes the Blacksmith} {key:hi}, {key:Yselda} and {key:yes}.
Jehan the Baker: getting the task
Talk to {npc:Jehan the Baker}: {key:hi} and {key:Yselda}. He is short of bread and asks for **10 {item:Bread}**.
With the 10 breads in your inventory, say {key:Yselda} and {key:yes}.
Talk to the sorcerer {npc:Onfroi}: {key:hi} and {key:Yselda}. He asks you to destroy **20** of the creatures that are awakening in the crypt: the {creature:Crypt Warrior|Crypt Warriors}.
The {creature:Crypt Warrior|Crypt Warriors} roam the island's **ground floor** during the **night**. Kill 20.
Crypt Warriors are immune to death damage and take 125% holy damage.
Dal the Huntress: getting the task
Talk to {npc:Dal the Huntress}: {key:hi} and {key:Yselda}. She asks you to hunt **20 {creature:Deer}** in the woods of Bounac.
Kill 20 {creature:Deer} in the woods of Bounac (there are some around the city). Keep the {item:Ham} they drop: it is used for Fral's task.
Deer run away when you attack them; a distance weapon or a spell helps.
Go back to {npc:Dal the Huntress} and say {key:Yselda} to hand in the task (the wiki does not have the hand-in dialogue).
Fral the Butcher: getting the task
Talk to {npc:Fral the Butcher}: {key:hi} and {key:Yselda}. He asks for about **20 {item:Ham}**.
With the 20 {item:Ham} in your inventory, say {key:Yselda} and {key:yes}.
Fral's trust (with all five tasks done, you can enter the castle)
4. Entering the castle and talking to Kesar the Younger

With the trust of the five inhabitants, a guard of the Order lets you into the castle. {npc:Kesar the Younger} is only in the throne room **during the day**; at night he is in his quarters, one floor below.
Go up to the **3rd floor** (floor +3) via the stairs where {npc:Onfroi} stands during the day, head **north** and then **west** to the {npc:Bounac Guard}. Say {key:hi}, {key:pass} and {key:yes}.
Go up to the throne room

Go up **two more floors**. {npc:Kesar the Younger} is on the **left** side of the throne room (only during the day). Say {key:hi} and {key:siege}. He asks you to wait until he has time for your request.
Wait **at least 10 minutes** without talking to Kesar again. The safest option is to wait **11 minutes**.
If you talk to Kesar before the 10 minutes are up, the timer restarts and you have to wait another 10.
Once that time has passed (and while it is still daytime), say {key:siege} to {npc:Kesar the Younger} and then {key:yes} to his proposal. He warns that Fugue, Drume or both will show up there soon.

Now you have to wait **one Tibian day** (one real hour). If you want to leave the castle in the meantime, go down to the floor **below the throne room**, follow the ramp **south** and step into the **elevator**. From then on, that elevator also works as a **shortcut** into the castle.
Use the wait to restock: the next step is a fight against Fugue.

Once the Tibian day has passed (one real hour), on the **following night** stay in or enter Kesar's room (the throne room). {creature:Fugue} appears together with **5 {creature:Usurper Warlock|Usurper Warlocks}**.
Fugue hits hard: melee up to about 1,444, ice up to about 1,500 and death up to about 800 damage.

Kill {creature:Fugue} (32,000 HP). With a small team, or even as a duo with a blocker and a healer, it is straightforward damage with no complications. Without a blocker, or below level 400, lure Fugue **out of the room** and close the door to protect yourself from the Usurpers; if things get tight, you can go down the stairs.
Fugue disappears if you do not kill him within a few minutes of his appearance, so going up and down the stairs repeatedly may not be enough.
Fugue drops no loot (it was removed after an abuse in 2020), but he gives 23,000 experience.

Wait until it is **daytime** again and go to the throne room (if you left the castle, come back by the elevator or via the {npc:Bounac Guard}, as in step 4). Say {key:siege} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. If you have already completed the Order of the Falcon and Order of the Cobra accesses, he asks you to escort him to the Usurpers' camp: say {key:yes}. He replies that they have to wait for the skirmishes on the coast to calm down.

If you do not yet have access to the Order of the Falcon ({wiki:The Secret Library Quest|The Secret Library Quest}) and the Order of the Cobra ({wiki:Grave Danger Quest|Grave Danger Quest}), Kesar first sends you to investigate the other orders in Edron and in the desert to the south. Complete them and come back.

On the next Tibian day, talk to {npc:Kesar the Younger} again: {key:siege} and {key:yes}. He teleports you to a small room from where you watch his meeting with Drume, in the fields on the **east** side of the island.
Listen to Kesar after the meeting
The peace talks fail. When the meeting is over, talk to {npc:Kesar the Younger} again about {key:siege}: Drume wants war and they will face him on the battlefield near the **east** coast of Bounac.
The wiki does not describe how you leave the small meeting room. If you are not taken back, look for Kesar in the throne room during the day.

You can fight with a team of **up to 5 players** (you and 4 more). Bring protection against **Earth** and **Death**, use **Death** damage (especially on the Commanders) and **do not use Earth**: Drume is immune.

Go back to the **east** part of the island and go up the ramp to the fields. The wiki only says *"the area east of the island, again"* (Drume's page mentions fields to the **south-east**): this is the area where you fetched the ledger and the map, through the tunnel under the windmill ({coord:32427,32461,7}) and the cave to the **south-east**. When you enter, you find yourself in the middle of several members of the Order of the Lion: there are three squads on each side (Lions and Usurpers).
Tunnel stairs next to the windmill

The first objective is to kill the 3 {creature:Usurper Commander|Usurper Commanders}. The ordinary Usurpers and Lions attack each other, but the Commanders **always attack you**. Since they do not all appear in the same spot, advance slowly to the **south-west** to pull one at a time. When a Commander dies, his squad disappears.
Set the {wiki:Battle Window|Battle Window} to *Sort Descending by Name*: that way the Commanders always appear at the top of the list.
If the three {creature:Lion Commander|Lion Commanders} die, you lose the battle and are thrown out. Do not attack them.

After the Commanders, {creature:Kesar} and {creature:Drume} appear. Kesar does not move, but Drume can attack him. Drume attacks any Lion or player and switches targets often: use the Lions as blockers to take less damage. One of the Order of the Falcon leaders may also appear with him ({creature:Grand Chaplain Gaunder}, {creature:Grand Canon Dominus}, {creature:Grand Commander Soeren} or {creature:Preceptor Lazare}); this helper always attacks the same target as Drume.
Drume (35,000 HP) attacks in melee (up to 600+), throws knives in a 3 sqm ball (670–700), does a 6 sqm wave, throws assassin stars and fires a poisoned arrow that deals up to 1,000 death damage.
25,000 experience and Drume's loot (see the table in the next step)
Drume always drops an {item:Energy Bar} and {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, and can drop pieces of the {wiki:Lion Set|Lion Set} (very rare). Some interesting items:
Other Lion pieces ({item:Lion Amulet}, {item:Lion Plate}, {item:Lion Longbow}, etc.)
very rare (the wiki gives no percentage)

After the fight, go back the same way: go down the ramp, return through the cave (to the **north-west**) to the stairs next to the windmill ({coord:32427,32461,7}), go down them again and follow the cave **south** to the city to talk to Kesar. The wiki does not document any other exit from the fields (nor where you are taken if you lose the battle).
Talk to Kesar one last time

Go to the throne room (during the day) and say {key:siege} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He names you **Hero of Bounac**: you receive the achievement **Lionheart** and the title **Hero of Bounac** (on your next login). You gain access to all areas of Bounac, including the depot, and you can trade with the city's NPCs, with perks at the court trader {npc:Augustin}. The large house south of Bounac is at your disposal, and Kesar also tells you about a small house further south on the island.
Lionheart achievement, Hero of Bounac title, full access to Bounac and its depot

From now on you can fight {creature:Drume} again every **20 hours** to try to loot pieces of the {wiki:Lion Set|Lion Set}. Take the same route as for the battle (east part of the island, go up the ramp to the fields); the wiki does not detail how the repeat works.
Some pieces have a minimum level to use them: the {item:Lion Plate} and the {item:Lion Longbow} require level 270 and the {item:Lion Amulet} level 230.
sword, axe and club fighting +3; physical +6%

To leave the castle, use the elevator (floor below the throne room, ramp **south**). The wiki **does not document** the return trip from Bounac to the mainland: look for the boat where you disembarked to go back to Edron. If there is no return trip, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (Daily Reward or Store): it takes you to your temple, but it does not work in no-logout zones or with a logout block or PZ block. In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to the other cities.
This quest unlocks {wiki:The Order of the Stag Quest|The Order of the Stag Quest} and the mission *Galthen and the Lost Queen* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest|Adventures of Galthen Quest}.

The Lionheart achievement describes you as the one who defeated Drume and Fugue, conquered the Order of the Cobra's fortress and beat the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon: that is why both Bastions are mandatory.
Drume is in the Bosstiary as an **Archfoe**.
In 2020, shortly after release, it was possible to force Fugue to spawn in order to farm his loot; CipSoft removed his loot and banned more than 1500 accounts that abused it.
